proposal.observation: ZN-E005 config (shared ResConv over all 300 points + masked summary + linear head): 3-split MAPE 0.332±0.009, Acc@15 0.334±0.080, RMSE 383±54; split 2021 MAPE 0.3216 / Acc@15 0.4055 / RMSE 445.0. On every split long-life cells are underpredicted (500-1000 bias -450..-600, >1000 bias -930..-1050). prepare.preprocess_cycle builds each cycle as [charge 150 | discharge 150]; the shared stem's kernels straddle index 150 and both phases share every filter.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: Encoding charge and discharge halves with separate residual Conv1D branches (each d_model/2 = 32 channels, no kernel crossing the phase boundary) gives phase-specific Zn-ion features (plating/stripping plateaus, end-of-charge polarization) that separate long-life cells: split-2021 MAPE <= 0.3136 or RMSE <= 424.0 vs ZN-E005, with lower 500-1000 and >1000 band MAPE.
proposal.question_inherited: Does a phase-aware curve encoder reduce long-life underprediction on ZN-coin?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Whether mixing charge/discharge in one shared encoder hides phase-specific ageing signatures.
proposal.why_this_experiment: User wants a genuinely new, non-CPMLP model; ResConv family closed (A2 follow-ups used). architecture.md §2.1 curve encoder role + §3 'curve inflection loss -> Conv1D'; Zn-ion domain: charge-first/discharge-first cells exist (prepare.ZN_COIN_CHARGE_FIRST), so phase identity matters. One mechanism vs ZN-E005: curve encoder split by phase; summary and head unchanged.
proposal.modification: Curve encoder only: shared stem (3->32->64->64) + 2 residual blocks over 300 points -> two branches, charge [3,150] and discharge [3,150], each Conv1d 3->16 k7 s2, 16->32 k5 s2, 32->32 k3 s2 + 2 ResidualCurveBlock(32) + avg pool -> concat [B,100,64]. Masked mean/last/last-first summary, Linear(192->64), ReLU, Linear(64->1) unchanged.
proposal.changed_components: Curve encoder (shared -> phase-split). Params 85,697 -> 49,857 (half-width branches); code T002 (refactor verified behaviour-preserving for older variants).
proposal.held_constant_components: Masked summary, inter_summary Linear(192->64), linear head (0 MLP blocks), d_model 64, dropout 0.1, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, data.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE (tools/rescore.py) vs ZN-E005; EOL-band MAPE and bias; pred SD/corr; charge/discharge branch gradients and updates; padding sensitivity; params/time.
proposal.rejection_condition: Primary rule (program.md §7, vs ZN-E005 MAPE 0.3216 / RMSE 445.0 / Acc@15 0.4055 / DB-MAPE 0.3216). KEEP iff [A: MAPE <= 0.3136 AND RMSE <= 455.0] OR [B: RMSE <= 424.0 AND MAPE <= 0.3246] OR [C: Acc@15 >= 0.4255 AND MAPE <= 0.3246 AND RMSE <= 455.0], AND Acc@15 >= 0.3755 (A/B) AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3316 AND gradient gate PASS AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; otherwise DISCARD. Secondary: EOL-band MAPE/bias.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; charge/discharge stem and residual gradients and updates, inter_summary and head gradients; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput.

architecture_addendum.mechanism: Phase-split residual Conv1D (separate charge and discharge branches)
architecture_addendum.evidence: Long-life underprediction on all 3 splits; shared kernels straddle the charge/discharge boundary at index 150
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> charge [B*100,3,150] -> stem+2 res -> pool [B,100,32]; discharge same -> [B,100,32]; concat [B,100,64] -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> ReLU -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: per-cycle encoding (padded cycles encoded independently, GroupNorm within one cycle's phase only); mean over mask==1, last at mask.sum()-1, delta last - cycle1. tests/test_phase_split_encoder.py: padding invariance and phase isolation.
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE (= MAPE, one domain) vs ZN-E005; EOL bands; gradient gate; charge vs discharge branch gradients
